div.div:
Legend
Yellow - application services Orange - data plane (ATP) Green - OCI observability
Solid arrow - synchronous request path Dashed arrow - async / telemetry export
One oracleApmTraceId joins every hop; studio.run_id joins AI Studio across APM and Langfuse.
Public diagram - DNS uses placeholder hosts only; no OCIDs, IPs, datakeys, or tenancy names.
